item.title: Venice Film Festival ends with Golden Lion at stake after 'NAZA' draws record ovation
item.description: The documentary "NAZA," in which Israeli military insiders describe what they call the systemic killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza, received a 25-minute standing ovation — the longest on record.

item.title: How Gillian Anderson opened her mind to desires that go far beyond a person's sex life
item.description: Gillian Anderson is known for her work in X-Files and The Crown. But her role in Sex Education convinced her that she wanted to encourage women to talk about the fantasies they've kept secret.

item.title: Two Juilliard students created a global art project in the wake of 9/11
item.description: Sing for Hope, which creates artist-decorated pianos and puts them in public spaces for everyone to enjoy, started after two Juilliard students thought about giving up performing in the wake of 9/11.

item.title: 'Practical Magic 2' can't break the curse of the Hollywood sequel
item.description: Nicole Kidman and Sandra Bullock return, playing witchy sisters living under a centuries-old family spell. Practical Magic 2 is a mildly enjoyable sequel that's bigger on fan service than freshness.

item.title: After 900 years, the Bayeux Tapestry returns to England and goes on display in London
item.description: The nearly 230-foot long Bayeux Tapestry is back in England for the first time in 900 years. It depicts the 1066 Battle of Hastings, a turning point in English history that ended Anglo-Saxon rule.

item.title: After a bicycle crash, some motorcyclists stopped to help
item.description: A photojournalist was stuck, injured and without cell service, after he crashed into a boulder on his bicycle in Scotland. Three motorcyclists stopped to help.
